docs.title: First Post
docs.text: Writing never reaches a final state. Every paragraph can be rewritten, every sentence rephrased, every word replaced. There are always a few rough edges to polish. So, I'd rather see these posts not as perfected writings but as published drafts. There is no optimal point for a text. You start with a few words, and after some iterations, end up with a text that looks not perfect but fine. That’s why this blog is called Non-Convex Space.
